settings.title: Apply with a recent post
settings.text: We read the work. There is no follower minimum.

settings.title: We send a code for diamonds and gold
settings.text: The code covers loose lab-grown diamonds and gold jewelry. Choose one gold piece if you want to post it.

settings.title: You post, your audience uses the code
settings.text: Tag @laurasgemsnyc. Say when a piece was gifted, and say that you earn from the code.

settings.title: The code
settings.text: Your code is 10% off loose lab-grown diamonds and gold jewelry: lab-grown diamond jewelry and gold chains. It does not combine with LMNYWELCOME or any other offer. One use per customer. The code is for your audience, not for your own order.

settings.title: What you earn
settings.text: You earn 10% of what your audience pays for those eligible pieces, after your code and before tax and shipping.

settings.title: When we pay
settings.text: We pay once a month, after the 14-day return window closes. A return comes off the balance. The balance carries until it reaches $50.

settings.title: The piece
settings.text: You can choose one gold piece from lab-grown jewelry or our chains. It is yours to keep. Loose lab-grown diamonds stay in the store.

settings.title: The post
settings.text: If you take a piece, post one feed post or Reel and two Stories in the 14 days after it arrives. Tag @laurasgemsnyc. Say the piece was gifted. Name the metal, and say lab-grown when the diamond is lab-grown. Do not invent who owned a piece, and do not say a celebrity wears something we sell.

settings.title: How we decide
settings.text: We reply from hello@lauramilman.com. We choose from the work, not from a follower count.

settings.title: Wear it. Share it.
settings.intro: The Laura Milman influencer program is for people who post about lab-grown diamonds and gold jewelry. Accepted creators receive a code for those pieces, and can choose one gold piece to wear and post.
settings.success_message: Thank you. We read every application and reply from hello@lauramilman.com.
settings.privacy_note: We use this only to reply about the program.
